commands_used: answer 1. I work for the order hunting the Eye of Argonia, a jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root under the sea. The Unbound drain trees and seal them with grey poison, and I want to beat them to it. The knight-captain tomb led me to this mine, Vicrium. 2. Get into the lower galleries of Vicrium and search the knights strongbox there. 3. Get the key from Ah-Zish by good words or 100 gold, or steal it from him, or go through the old lower adit on the creek bank, through crocodile water. Smugglers are in the lower galleries, so I can fight or sneak. 4. I do not know why the Unbound drain trees, or how Nesh-Deeka knows things. I could ask people and read what I find.
pick Door to Lower Galleries win

answer 1. I got into Vicrium through the old adit (the key from Ah-Zish never reached my pack) and took an old parchment map from the knights strongbox. It shows seven towers standing in the sea and a tooth-shaped crag on an island, probably a clue to the Root and the Eye of Argonia, which I am racing the Unbound to. 2. Bring the map to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. 3. I can travel straight to Helstrom, or first look at the map more closely or deal with the smuggler here. I see no other choice. 4. I do not know where the seven towers or the tooth crag are, or why Nesh-Deeka wants the map and how she knows things. Nesh-Deeka may tell me.

answer 1. Nesh-Deeka took the map, says it is another step to the Eye of Argonia, and that her officer will read the seven towers and tooth crag. The Unbound have not reached Vicrium. She promoted me to Toh-Wo, Secret-Speaker, second rank, with 200 gold. 2. Choose the order gift from Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. 3. A rapier or a quarterstaff. A rapier suits a quick sneaky character. 4. I still do not know how she knows things (she only says we listen), who her officer is, or where the towers are.

answer 1. I took the rapier from Nesh-Deeka. She passed me to her officer Never-Writes-Twice, who reads the map of seven towers and the tooth crag. It is all a trail to the Eye of Argonia before the Unbound. 2. Show the map to Never-Writes-Twice, at the back of this same room. 3. Just talk to her; nothing else is offered. 4. I do not know what the map means, or why the Unbound drain trees; Never-Writes-Twice may explain the map.

answer 1. The quest is complete. The map crag is the Grey Tooth, seamark of Skeith Isle, reached by boat to Archon and Arorha, and she marked it. She warned me about Cuts-the-Old-Knot, a former order member who went mad on sap and killed her minders. 2. Nothing is set now; the next step would be sailing toward Skeith Isle. 3. Go by boat via Archon and Arorha to the Grey Tooth. 4. I do not know where the seven towers are, who Cuts-the-Old-Knot is now, why the Unbound drain trees, or how the order knows things.

answer Notes: Down into Vicrium done. At Vicrium, Ah-Zish dialogue said it gave me the key (persuade, then 100 gold) but nothing reached my pack, so I went through the Old Lower Adit and took the Old Parchment Map from the Knights Strongbox; a smuggler was there but I did not fight. I gave it to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom, who named me Toh-Wo, Secret-Speaker (second rank), paid 200 gold and gave me Toh-Wo Rapier. I now report to her officer Never-Writes-Twice, who identified the crag as the Grey Tooth, seamark of Skeith Isle, reached by boat to Archon and Arorha. She warned me off Cuts-the-Old-Knot, a former order member gone mad on sap who killed her minders. I carry the rapier, lockpicks, Grey Seal paralysis poison x3, bronze disc, Old Silver Setting, Unbound note, keystone, and about 850 gold (the 100 for the key may or may not have been taken). Next: go to Archon and Arorha and take a boat to Skeith Isle for the Eye of Argonia, which heals every tree and lies at the Root under the sea. Open questions: where the seven towers are, why the Unbound drain trees, how the order knows things (we listen).
